o.text: Borrowed from Russian парла́мент (parláment), from French parlement.
Borrowed from Classical Persian اهل ایمان (ahl-i īmān).
From Proto-Common Turkic *čom- / *čöm-, possibly via Persian چمچه (čomče), where -če a diminutive suffix.
Ultimately calque of English worldview. Izafet II compound of dünya + görüş.
